cases.prompt: We added @NotBlank to our request record and the empty value still reaches the service. Nothing throws.
expectations: Checks that the spring-boot-starter-validation dependency is present
Checks that @Valid is on the body parameter so validation runs during argument resolution
Adds a test that fails on an empty value instead of trusting that the annotation is enough

cases.prompt: Our update endpoint accepts a null reference. The field has groups set to the create group.
expectations: Explains that a constraint with an explicit group never runs for another group or for Default
Adds the missing group or restructures the type so the constraint runs in both flows
Adds one test per group proving the constraint runs in that group and not in the others

cases.prompt: We need to reject values that are not a valid IBAN on a request record field.
expectations: Writes a constraint annotation with runtime retention, groups, payload, and a message-bundle key
Includes FIELD, PARAMETER, RECORD_COMPONENT, and TYPE_USE in the target so it works on records and containers
Returns true for null and blank so presence stays with NotNull or NotBlank, and compiles the pattern once

cases.prompt: endDate must be after startDate and clients need a field level error for it.
expectations: Uses a class-level constraint with a validator and addPropertyNode to target the field
Rejects the AssertTrue shortcut because its synthetic property name would become part of the published contract
Puts the message key in the user messages bundle and tests the exact error path

cases.prompt: Our validation errors come back in three different shapes depending on whether the violation came from a body, a query parameter, or a service method. Normalize them.
expectations: Maps MethodArgumentNotValidException, HandlerMethodValidationException, and ConstraintViolationException into one ProblemDetail body
Includes field, code, and message per entry with deterministic ordering and deduplication
Excludes the rejected value, the entity class, and the raw exception message, and pins the shape with a contract test

cases.prompt: Our service starts with a relay host of an empty string and only fails when the first email is sent.
expectations: Adds @Validated to the ConfigurationProperties record with NotBlank and a nested @Valid record
States that the failure is a BindValidationException that aborts the context refresh
Adds a context test asserting startup fails for a bad value
